title: A different summer
passage: Last summer, my family and I (1)____ to a small village in the mountains. It was (2)____ unforgettable trip. The village was far from the city, (3)____ we had to take a bus for three hours. When we arrived, the villagers (4)____ us warmly. I was surprised to see an old man teaching children to read (5)____ a big tree. He had been a teacher for forty years. (6)____ he was over seventy, he still worked every day. 'Teaching children (7)____ me happy,' he said with a smile. I helped him clean the classroom, and he taught me (8)____ a poem. Before we left, he told me, 'The more you learn, the (9)____ you will be.' I will never forget (10)____ him.

blanks.hint: Last summer 是过去时间状语，用一般过去时。
unforgettable 以元音音素开头，用 an。
前因后果，用 so 表示“所以”。
全文是过去时，谓语用 welcomed。
在大树底下用 under the big tree。
“七十多岁了”和“仍每天工作”是让步关系，用 Although。
动名词 Teaching 作主语，谓语用单数 makes；引语中陈述一般事实。
teach sb to do sth。
the + 比较级，the + 比较级，表示“越……越……”。
forget doing 表示忘记做过的事。

hint: 先通读全文抓住大意（一次山村之行），再逐空判断时态、连词和固定搭配。

title: A teacher who changed many lives
passage: Zhang Guimei is a teacher in Yunnan. Many years ago, she noticed that some girls in her class suddenly (1)____ school. She found out that their families were too poor to pay for their education. Zhang was very (2)____ about it. She decided to do something. In 2008, she (3)____ the first free high school for girls in China. Life was hard at the beginning. She had many (4)____, but she never gave up. (5)____ how hard it was, she kept working. She (6)____ her own money on her students. She often says, 'I want my girls to have a (7)____ future.' Thanks to her, more than two thousand girls have (8)____ college. Her story has (9)____ many people across the country. It reminds us that even a small person can make a big (10)____.

blanks.hint: 下文说家里太穷缴不起学费，所以是“离开学校”辍学了。
-ed 形容词修饰人，表示“感到担心”。
创办一所学校用 started/founded。
but she never gave up 说明前面是“困难”。
No matter how + 形容词，表示“无论多么……”。
spend money on sb/sth，主语是人。
和现状对比，用比较级 better future。
考上/进入大学用 enter college；join 后接组织，take part in 后接活动。
“感动了很多人”用 touched。
make a big difference 是固定搭配，表示“产生很大影响”。

hint: 故事类完形先通读全文，抓住人物和事件线索，再逐空判断；动词、名词要看上下文语境。

title: How to use your phone wisely
passage: Nowadays, almost every student has a smartphone. It can help us in many ways. We can look (1)____ new words in a dictionary app. We can also learn English by (2)____ to English songs. However, spending too much time (3)____ games is bad for our eyes and our study. Some students stay up late playing games, so they feel (4)____ in class the next day. What should we do? First, we should decide how much time we can spend (5)____ the phone every day. Second, we'd better put our phones away (6)____ we do our homework. Third, remember (7)____ the screen before you go to bed. If we use the phone in a right way, it will be a good (8)____, not a problem. (9)____ we use it well, it can really help us learn (10)____.

blanks.hint: look up 表示查阅（单词、资料）。
by 是介词，后面接动名词。
spend time doing sth。
sleepy 是形容词，表示“困倦的”，作 feel 的表语。
spend time on sth。
“做作业的同时”用 while 引导时间状语从句。
remember to do 表示记着去做（还没做）。
not a problem 对应前面的“好帮手”。
“如果我们用得好”是条件，用 If 引导条件状语从句。
修饰动词 learn 用副词，和以前对比用比较级 better。

hint: 说明文完形注意首尾句的观点，注意固定搭配（look up / spend time doing / remember to do）。
